literal_meaning: তুচ্ছ এবং তাচ্ছিল্য প্রদর্শন করা (trivial and contemptuous treatment to do)
similar_in_english: To look down one's nose at
To turn up one's nose at
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে তার শিক্ষকের মতামতকে তুচ্ছতাচ্ছিল্য করল।
এই আচরণে সকলে তাকে তুচ্ছতাচ্ছিল্য করবে।
example_sentences_in_english: He showed contempt for his teacher's opinion.
Everyone will show disrespect for such behavior.
note: This idiom reflects everyday Bengali expressions of disdain, with 'তুড়ি মারা' as a colloquial synonym implying light, dismissive beating.
